column1:
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Hambantota to Trincomalee via Pottuvil and Batticaloa during the evening or night.
Winds will be variable in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
